title: Uniform final soundness theorem target
purpose: Make the exact all-input-size theorem that must be discharged by code explicit, machine-readable, and checker-visible.

theoremToDischarge.statement: For every Boolean/NAND SAT input family instance phi, the repository provides a uniform polynomial-time construction and checker-accepted proof path such that locked NAND thresholding plus residual-band minimization decides SAT in polynomial time; therefore SAT is in P and P equals NP.
theoremToDischarge.inputQuantifier: all finite SAT/NAND inputs, uniformly by input size
theoremToDischarge.requiredConclusion: SAT in P, hence P = NP
mustNotUse: finite-size extrapolation without a uniform schema
bounded small-model evidence as a theorem discharge
oracle access to SAT or exact minimization
external review as a mathematical premise

requiredUniformObligations.statement: The accepted proof object quantifies over every finite SAT/NAND input size and has a single uniform schema, not a finite list of checked instances.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Rejects bounded-only evidence and accepts only a schema with explicit all-size quantification and polynomial-time instantiation.

requiredUniformObligations.statement: The locked NAND construction W_phi and threshold B_phi are generated uniformly in polynomial time for every input phi.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Checks construction totality, size bound, runtime bound, and deterministic source-to-instance mapping for all inputs.

requiredUniformObligations.statement: For every input phi, phi is satisfiable iff the locked NAND minimum-size threshold condition holds.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Checks the SAT-to-locked-NAND semantic equivalence theorem uniformly, not only by small-model truth tables.

requiredUniformObligations.statement: PCCMin solves every locked NAND residual-band instance produced by the construction in polynomial time and returns the exact minimum.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Checks exactness, termination, polynomial iteration count, certificate-size bounds, and uniform package coverage.

requiredUniformObligations.statement: The ZeroSlack contradiction, selector universe, HN/BUD closure, and packet extraction cover all ranks and all generated inputs uniformly.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Checks rank-parametric closure with no finite-rank extrapolation and no missing selector family.

requiredUniformObligations.statement: The executable proof path contains no hidden SAT oracle, exact-minimization oracle, unbounded search, or semantic shortcut.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Extends source-surface scanning to semantic/import/template coverage for the restricted checker language.

requiredUniformObligations.statement: The accepted uniform SAT decision procedure is polynomial, and the standard implication SAT in P => P = NP is checker-bound.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Binds SAT NP-completeness, polynomial construction, polynomial minimization, and final P = NP conclusion as proof objects.

requiredUniformObligations.statement: Release.UnrestrictedFinalSoundness may be cleared only by accepted uniform proof checkers, not by external review, prose, or historical report wording.
requiredUniformObligations.acceptanceCriterion: Clears the release blocker only when UFS-001 through UFS-007 are all accepted and hash-bound.
